request: A subcommand that writes the plan must refuse a path git keeps out of version control and name it, because a plan that cannot be committed carries no evidence to a review; a tracked or force-added path keeps working.

defects.description: Own-history fix af16a4a2c9 (2026-10-09): fix(plan): refuse plan writes at a path git keeps out of version control

trigger.input:
printf %s  | base64 -d > cmd/tsp/zz_probe_test.go
if go test -count=1 -run \^TestPlanWritesRefuseAPathGitIgnores\$ ./cmd/tsp >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo probe: pass; else echo probe: fail; fi

defects.why_missed: The project's own suite at the parent commit never exercised this input; the fix commit added the test that does.
